notes.subject: מֵעֹבֵר וּמִשָּׁב
notes.rationale: 'Of passer-by and returner': adverbial genitives — 'no one passed through or returned' (KJV) vs YLT 'of any passing by and turning back' as measure of desolation.

notes.subject: חמדה/לשמה/נשמה
notes.rationale: Desirable-land (ḥemda) against desolation (shama), with nishma repeated — the sound-play ḥemda/shamma is lost in Bambara.

notes.subject: סערם
notes.rationale: 'I storm-tossed them': ne ye u yɛlɛ ni subabiri ye keeps the storm picture; 'scatter' (KJV) drops the wind.

translation: Ani ne ye u yɛlɛ ni subabiri ye, ka u bila siya bɛɛ kɔnɔ, minnu ma u ye dɔn; dugukolo sigira yɔrɔ jɛlen ye u bɔlen kɔfɛ — mɔgɔ si ma se ka taa walima ka segin; u ye dugukolo min tun di kosɛbɛ, o kɛra yɔrɔ jɛlen ye.

tokens.gloss: ne ye u yɛlɛ ni subabiri ye
